verdict.rationale: The evidence shows CoreWeave running batch workloads: Slurm jobs inside Kubernetes via SUNK, and managed CKS clusters. Nothing documents scheduling jobs or workflows to recur (cron-style schedules, recurring Slurm jobs, or a workflow scheduler). One-off batch execution and bucket lifecycle policies are adjacent features, not recurring scheduling, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
